instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Lumina is an environmental conservation foundation dedicated to protecting critical ecosystems through scientific research and on-the-ground habitat restoration. The organization manages a significant portfolio of protected areas, relying heavily on complex grant funding and public donations for operations. They leverage data science initiatives to enhance monitoring capabilities but operate with lean middle management, which strains existing resources.
answers.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. This project successfully utilized existing compliance infrastructure and resulted in a significant increase in new client retention rates, demonstrating successful incremental process innovation.
answers.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on a single product category and a concentrated customer base—our top 3 clients represent 55% of revenue. This concentration risk is unacceptable for our long-term health. We need to identify and develop new revenue streams, possibly including new product lines for different customer segments or entirely new business models that leverage our existing capabilities.
answers.additionalContext: Lumina has recently secured a major grant which requires reporting capabilities far exceeding current internal infrastructure, highlighting the immediate need for scalable technical solutions.
answers.teamSize: We have a small technology team of 4-6 people including developers, a part-time DevOps engineer, and a product manager who also handles project management. The team is fully allocated to maintaining current products and handling integration requests from key clients. Innovation work is done in the margins — there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Predictive Analytics for Habitat Health
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging the existing camera trap data and biodiversity identification tools to predict habitat stress or poaching hotspots allows for proactive resource allocation. This improves operational efficiency without requiring a full system overhaul.

first_actions: Integrate machine learning model training into current quarterly reporting cycles.
Pilot predictive analytics on one high-risk protected area.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: 15% reduction in field response time to predicted threats.

opportunities.title: Corporate ESG Certification Platform (Service Line)
opportunities.rationale: Develop a premium, subscription-based service that packages Lumina's monitoring data and conservation impact metrics into standardized reports for corporate clients. This moves the foundation beyond grants toward scalable diversified revenue.

first_actions: Define the core metrics required by large corporations (e.g., TCFD alignment).
Develop a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) for data visualization dashboards.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Legal counsel consultation on data privacy and liability
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure two corporate pilot contracts within 1 year.
milestones: Q4: Launch beta program with target clients

opportunities.title: Automated Compliance Reporting Engine
opportunities.rationale: Streamlining the high regulatory burden by automating data collection and reporting for mandatory governmental or grant requirements. This reduces manual labor costs and minimizes compliance risk.

first_actions: Audit current reporting workflows to identify automation opportunities.
Implement workflow automation tools (e.g., Zapier, internal script).
resources_needed: Subscription to an enterprise integration platform
execution_plan.success_metric: 20% reduction in time spent on manual compliance reporting.
milestones: Q3: Workflow mapping and tool selection complete
Q4: Automated reporting for one major grant completed

next_steps.action: Form a dedicated 'Diversification Task Force' to validate the Corporate ESG Platform concept.
Conduct a full process audit of current grant reporting and operational bottlenecks.
Allocate 5% budget for initial R&D/pilot phase of the AI-Driven Predictive Analytics project.

key_weaknesses: Limited dedicated innovation time and budget allocation, forcing initiatives into a reactive 'margin' mode.
High dependency on specialized, scarce technical talent (4-6 people) who are fully allocated to maintenance.
Fragmented operational processes across research, compliance, and field teams hindering scalable technology adoption.
Overwhelming regulatory complexity which creates significant risk regarding data handling and reporting accuracy.
